# Testing SNP differentiation using linear models

## Read filtered SNP table and load packages

Also sets the cowplot theme

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())

FF_genomes_filtered <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/FF_genomes_filtered.RDS")

```

## Linear models

### Plotting results from multiple tests

Note: model comparison analysis P values (comp_Pval) is NA when lm_Pval is 1. This occurs when the two groups being compared have the same mean and same variance.

```{r}
FF_2L <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/SNP_diff2L.RDS")
FF_2R <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/SNP_diff2R.RDS")
FF_3L <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/SNP_diff3L.RDS")
FF_3R <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/SNP_diff3R.RDS")
FF_X <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/SNP_diffX.RDS")

SNPdiff_data <- bind_rows(FF_2L, FF_2R, FF_3L, FF_3R, FF_X) %>% 
  mutate(CHROM = as.character(CHROM))

Xaxis_CHROM <- SNPdiff_data %>%  
  group_by(CHROM) %>% 
  summarise(center = (min(POS) + max(POS))/2)

# linear model (used in manuscript)
SNPdiff_data$lm_adjPval <- p.adjust(SNPdiff_data$lm_Pval, method = 'fdr')
# model comparison (Selection as mean factor vs. mean only)
SNPdiff_data$comp_adjPval <- p.adjust(SNPdiff_data$comp_Pval, method = 'fdr')
# t-test with unequal variance assumption
SNPdiff_data$tue_adjPval <- p.adjust(SNPdiff_data$tue_Pval, method = 'fdr')
# t-test with equal variance assumption, equivalent to lm
SNPdiff_data$te_adjPval <- p.adjust(SNPdiff_data$te_Pval, method = 'fdr')
# quasibionial model, unweighted
SNPdiff_data$qb_b_adjPval <- p.adjust(SNPdiff_data$qb_b_Pval, method = 'fdr')
# quasibinomial model, weighted
SNPdiff_data$qb_w_adjPval <- p.adjust(SNPdiff_data$qb_w_Pval, method = 'fdr')
```

### Plot of LM adjusted p-values

```{r}
# lm adjusted
pltmanu_lm_adj <- ggplot(data = SNPdiff_data, aes(
x = POS, y = -log10(lm_adjPval), size = -log10(lm_adjPval))) +
  facet_grid(.~ CHROM, scales = 'free_x', space = 'free_x',
             switch = 'x') +
  geom_point(aes(color = CHROM, alpha = -log10(lm_adjPval))) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
  values = rep(c("steelblue3", "skyblue"), 
               length(Xaxis_CHROM$CHROM))) +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.05, 0.8)) +
  labs(y = "-log10(Adjusted P-Value)",
       x = "Chromosome Arm",
       title = "Linear model: adjusted P-values") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = 'dotted', color = 'red') +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = 'none',
          panel.spacing.x = unit(0, 'lines'), 
          strip.background.x = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = 'outside') 

print(pltmanu_lm_adj)
```

#### Linear model: Plot P-values, read depth and allele frequency for target SNPs

```{r}
target_SNPs <- SNPdiff_data %>% filter(lm_adjPval < 0.05) 

target_SNPs_pvals <- target_SNPs %>% 
  mutate("SNP_ID" = paste(CHROM, POS, sep = '_')) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("Pval"),
               names_to = "Res", values_to = "Pval") %>% 
  mutate("logPval" = -log10(Pval))



target_SNP_full <- semi_join(FF_genomes_filtered, target_SNPs)

target_SNP_full <- full_join(target_SNP_full, target_SNPs)

target_SNP_full <- target_SNP_full %>%
  dplyr::select(-REF, -ALT) %>% 
  mutate("SNP_ID" = paste(CHROM, POS, sep = '_')) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
  cols = c(starts_with('freq_'), starts_with('N_')),
  names_to = c(".value", "Population"),
  names_pattern = "(freq|N)_(.*)"
  ) %>% rename(depth = N) %>% 
  # Removes all text after the second underscore,
  # used to remove _G13_sample...
  # this leaves freq_CON1, N_CON1, and so on.
  mutate(Population = str_remove(Population, "_.*")) %>% 
  separate_wider_regex(
    cols = Population,
    patterns = c("Selection" = ".*", "PopReplicate" = "\\d$")
    ) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "PopReplicate"), factor)

SNPfreq_segments <- target_SNP_full %>% 
  group_by(SNP_ID, Selection, CHROM, POS) %>% 
  summarise(mSelfreq = mean(freq), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Selection, values_from = mSelfreq) %>% 
  mutate(selmin = pmin(CON, FP), selmax = pmax(CON, FP))

SNPdepth_segments <- target_SNP_full %>% 
  group_by(SNP_ID, Selection, CHROM, POS) %>% 
  summarise(mSeldepth = mean(depth), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Selection, values_from = mSeldepth) %>% 
  mutate(selmin = pmin(CON, FP), selmax = pmax(CON, FP))


# P values of different analyses
tSNP_resplot <- target_SNPs_pvals %>% filter(str_detect(Res, "adj")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = logPval, x = SNP_ID, color = Res)) +
                facet_wrap(~ Res, nrow = 2, ncol = 3) +
                geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), color = 'red', linetype = 'dotted')+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

print(tSNP_resplot)

chrom_labs <- c("2R" = "", "3L" = "3L", "3R" = "3R", "X" = "X")

# Read depth plot
depth_tSNP_plt <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = target_SNP_full, aes(
    x = SNP_ID, y = depth, color = Selection, shape = PopReplicate), 
    alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(data = SNPdepth_segments, aes(
    x = SNP_ID, xend = SNP_ID, y = selmin, yend = selmax), 
    color = 'gray30', linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(.~CHROM, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
          labeller = labeller(CHROM = as_labeller(chrom_labs))) +
  stat_summary(data = target_SNP_full, aes(
    x = SNP_ID, y = depth, color = Selection), 
    fun = mean, size = 1.8, shape = '-') +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Selection",
 values = c("CON" = 'steelblue', "FP" = 'firebrick')) +
 scale_shape_manual(name = "Replicate",
 values = c("1" = 15, "2" = 16, "3" = 17, "4" = 18)) +
geom_hline(yintercept = 20, color = 'red', linetype = 'dotted') +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 160, by = 20)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = 
    element_text(angle = 315, size = 6, hjust = 0.1, vjust = 0.5),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
  panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines")) +
  labs(y = "Read depth", x = "SNP_ID", shape = "Replicate")

print(depth_tSNP_plt)

# Frequency plot
freq_tSNP_plt <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = target_SNP_full, aes(
  x = SNP_ID, y = freq, color = Selection, shape = PopReplicate), 
    alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(data = SNPfreq_segments, aes(
    x = SNP_ID, xend = SNP_ID, y = selmin, yend = selmax), 
    color = 'gray30', linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(.~CHROM, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
          labeller = labeller(CHROM = as_labeller(chrom_labs))) +
  stat_summary(data = target_SNP_full, aes(
    x = SNP_ID, y = freq, color = Selection), 
    fun = mean, size = 1.8, shape = '-') +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Selection",
 values = c("CON" = 'steelblue', "FP" = 'firebrick')) +
 scale_shape_manual(name = "Replicate",
 values = c("1" = 15, "2" = 16, "3" = 17, "4" = 18)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = 
    element_text(angle = 315, size = 6, hjust = 0.1, vjust = 0.5),
  panel.grid.major.y = 
    element_line(
      color = 'lightgray', linewidth = 0.5, linetype = 'dotted'),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
  panel.spacing = unit(0.15, "lines")) +
  labs(y = "Reference allele frequency", x = "SNP_ID", 
       shape = "Replicate")

print(freq_tSNP_plt)

# allele frequency vs. read depth plot
freq_depth_scatter <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = target_SNP_full, aes(
  y = freq, x = depth, color = Selection, shape = PopReplicate)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Selection",
 values = c("CON" = 'steelblue', "FP" = 'firebrick')) +
 scale_shape_manual(name = "Replicate",
 values = c("1" = 15, "2" = 16, "3" = 17, "4" = 18)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20, color = 'red', linetype = 'dotted')+
  labs(x = "Read depth", y = "Allele frequency", 
       shape = "Replicate")

print(freq_depth_scatter)

```

#### Assemble figure using patchwork

```{r}
depth_frq_SNPfig <- depth_tSNP_plt/freq_depth_scatter + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

print(depth_frq_SNPfig)
```

```{r}
write_rds(file = "../../../Big_data/lm_targetSNPs.RDS")
```
